rca_of_issue: CRITICAL INCIDENT — Accidental game deletion during testing. Root Cause: Backend test incorrectly assumed the DELETE /api/admin/games/cleanup/by-source endpoint supports a dry_run=true query parameter. The endpoint signature only has 'source: str' and 'user/db' dependencies — extra query params are silently ignored by FastAPI. When the test called DELETE .../by-source?source=gamemonetize&dry_run=true, FastAPI ignored dry_run=true and executed the actual deletion of all 119 gamemonetize games. Reproduction: Call DELETE /api/admin/games/cleanup/by-source?source=gamemonetize with admin auth — all gamemonetize games are deleted immediately. Mitigation Applied: (1) Re-imported 130 games from GameMonetize API via /api/admin/gamemonetize/bulk-import endpoint. (2) Updated test_cleanup_validation.py to use safe non-destructive validation — verify valid_sources via error message when using an obviously invalid source name, instead of calling the actual destructive endpoint. Future Prevention: Add dry_run=true support to the endpoint, or document in test guidelines that this endpoint is destructive and must not be called in tests.
